name: What is the average cost of a kitchen remodel in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a kitchen remodel in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen remodel in Las Vegas can vary widely, but homeowners typically spend between $20,000 and $60,000 for a mid-range project. High-end remodels with custom cabinetry, premium countertops, and professional-grade appliances can exceed $100,000. Factors influencing cost include the size of the kitchen, quality of materials, labor rates, and any structural changes. We provide detailed estimates after a thorough consultation to align with your budget and vision.
